The upstream author identifies the artwork as CC-BY; no version is specified.
Commercial use with credit to Konett is expressly allowed on the project page.
The original upstream README is preserved as UPSTREAM-README.md.
PNG layers are unmodified. File hashes and dimensions: provenance.json.

SARKISIAN's browser interface and canvas compositor were written separately.
This pack contains a single standing view, ending around the knees.
It does not include walking, sitting, hand gestures or additional camera views.
